sentences.text: Further, he submits that application seeking enhancement of compensation under Section 64(1) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re- settlement Act, 2013 cannot be dismissed for non- prosecution and it was obligatory on the Court to adjudicate the case based on the material.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respondents would submit that notice served on the brother is a valid service and the present appellant had knowledge of the proceeding and he did not appear before the Court and the Court is justified in dismissing the petition.
5. This Court has considered the contentions raised at the bar.
It is required to be noticed that under the provisions of the Act, notice on the application has to be served on the person whose property is acquired.
Moreover, the main object of the Act is to award just and fair compensation for the land looser.
Merely because the petitioner did not appear before the Court, the Courts are not bound to dismiss the petition for non-prosecution.
The Court has to determine the compensation payable to the land looser based on available materials.
The said exercise is not carried out.
Under the circumstance, the impugned order is set aside.
The matter is remitted to the trial Court to consider the matter in accordance with law.
6. The parties shall appear before the trial Court on 24th May, 2023 without awaiting any further notice from the trial Court.
7. The Court fee paid by the appellant shall be refunded to the appellant after due identification.
